rules.build:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/flit_core"
# flit_core is its own build backend bh_python_install --build
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/flit_core"
# The installer module needs flit_core to be built, so flit_core is installed # with the script it comes with for this. "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/python3" bootstrap_install.py \ --installdir "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/python3$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/python3/dist-packages" \ dist/flit_core-*.whl
